force_refresh.description: Trigger an immediate coordinator poll for loaded Mobile Alerts Cloud hub entries (guarded by rate limiting).

config_entry_id.name: Hub

migrate_from_legacy.name: Migrate from legacy mobile_alerts
migrate_from_legacy.description: Import missing sensors, device names, areas, entity metadata, and Recorder history from the legacy mobile_alerts integration into Mobile Alerts Cloud.

config_entry_id.description: The Mobile Alerts Cloud hub to migrate into. Required when several hubs are loaded.

dry_run.name: Preview only (dry run)
dry_run.description: Inspect the exact migration plan without modifying entries, devices, or entities.

cutover.name: Cutover (remove legacy entries & preserve history)
cutover.description: When enabled with dry_run disabled, removes legacy mobile_alerts entries and renames matching sensor entity IDs for seamless Recorder history continuity.

device_ids.description: Optional comma- or newline-separated 12-character hex sensor IDs to migrate selectively.

sensor_missing.title: Sensor {sensor} is no longer returned by the Mobile Alerts API
sensor_missing.description: The Mobile Alerts API has not returned the sensor {sensor} of hub {hub} for more than 24 hours. Check that the sensor is still registered with your gateway and that its ID is correct. If you no longer use it, delete the sensor from the hub. This issue disappears as soon as the API returns the sensor again.
